AI & Automation Engineering Intern - Summer 2027

The program takes place from June – August 2027 (10-week program).

Requirements

Rising Junior or Senior pursuing a Bachelor’s degree or a graduate student in an accredited college or university, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field

Excellent written, verbal and communication skills

Hands-on experience with at least one programming language preferred (Python preferred) through coursework, personal projects, or a prior internship

Familiarity with AI and large language model concepts, and demonstrated curiosity for applying them to real problems — coursework, personal projects, and hackathons all count

Comfort working with APIs, scripting, and connecting systems together

Proficiency in Windows and Microsoft Office

Ability to work independently with limited direction in a fast-paced environment; must be a high-energy, motivated self-starter

Benefits

As a paid intern at Example Employer, you’ll receive:

Paid Company Holidays during your internship

Tech Stipend to help set up your workspace

8 Hours of Paid Volunteer Time through our Example Employer Cares Program

Personal and Professional Development through our Internship Program

Access to Enterprise- Grade Software Gain new exposure and experience to multiple new tools, including the latest and cutting edge AI products in the market

We’re committed to providing a supportive and rewarding internship experience.

The pay range posted is an hourly rate of base pay. When making an offer of employment, Example Employer will take into consideration the candidate’s expectations, experience, education, scope of responsibility for the role, and the current market demands.
